summary: The hardened P2 final-soundness candidate is sound. external_entry_parameter_binding now fails closed: it returns unknown (entry_signature_not_frozen) with an empty witness unless entry_parameter events are non-empty and every event asserts entry_signature_complete=true, and it emits complete coverage only from that frozen domain. This removes the prior empty-domain false-acceptance path, and the absent-domain case is unit-tested. The reviewed candidate boundary is followed only by qualification/evidence rebinding. Candidate, tree, wheel and test bindings consistently reference 45ee3de/14eae235, 1908 passed plus 7 skipped, and wheel sha256 ea1c588667634740806817bea9b56fe4a8b72c14e8fd23d3dec3bf48c83b3e8d. The family-level 120-case minimum is substantiated. No false fact acceptance, terminal contribution, premature P5 authority, post-terminal model/tool call, or unsubstantiated mandatory gate was found.

non_blocking_findings.title: Per-predicate corpus coverage gap for external_entry_parameter_binding and guard_dominates_sink
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The 120-case corpus has 30 cases per provider family, while external_entry_parameter_binding and guard_dominates_sink have no dedicated corpus cases. The frozen P2 requirement is family-level and is satisfied, so this is defense-in-depth only.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add dedicated cases for the frozen-domain entry-binding path and guard dominance before P5.

non_blocking_findings.title: entry_signature_complete is a trusted frozen-IR assertion
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The checker gates on entry_parameter events whose attributes set entry_signature_complete=true. No current product producer emits those events, so the exact-binding positive path is not live in P2.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Before P5, bind producer-emitted signature completeness to independently checkable parameter count and identity facts.

checks.name: entry binding fails closed without a frozen signature domain
checks.evidence: registry.py requires non-empty entry_parameter events and entry_signature_complete=true for all such events, otherwise returning unknown with reason entry_signature_not_frozen.

checks.name: absent entry-signature domain is tested
checks.evidence: test_entry_parameter_binding_requires_frozen_signature_domain asserts unknown, an empty witness and no accepted fact.

checks.name: complete entry-binding coverage comes only from a frozen domain
checks.evidence: enumerated and required coverage are both derived from the non-empty frozen signature event UIDs.

checks.name: post-candidate boundary is evidence-only
checks.evidence: The reviewed implementation candidate is followed only by qualification, reachability, evidence-index and design-manifest rebinding before this review.

checks.name: candidate and tree bindings are exact
checks.evidence: Qualification, reachability and evidence records all bind 45ee3de1d637cc72434f656cac4b589aa5fc0750 and tree 14eae235198d884da2f3a8975a4d5e3d643a0336.

checks.name: test and wheel bindings are consistent
checks.evidence: The qualification records 1908 passed and 7 skipped and wheel sha256 ea1c588667634740806817bea9b56fe4a8b72c14e8fd23d3dec3bf48c83b3e8d.

checks.name: family-level corpus minimum is substantiated
checks.evidence: The answer-free corpus contains 120 cases: 10 positive and 20 near-miss safe cases for each of four provider families, with zero safe false acceptance.

checks.name: forged certificates cannot promote
checks.evidence: The checker independently recomputes predicates and rejects identity, dependency, code, IR, backend, witness, coverage, assumption, polarity and action mismatches.

checks.name: incomplete universal coverage fails closed
checks.evidence: Incomplete summaries and unfrozen exact-binding domains return unknown with empty witnesses, and the checker cannot accept incomplete coverage.

checks.name: model text cannot create facts or terminal contribution
checks.evidence: The finite provider/checker path is deterministic; derived RequiredFactPlan facts force terminal_contribution=none.

checks.name: Proof Kernel remains shadow until P5
checks.evidence: PROOF_KERNEL_MODE is a non-configurable shadow constant and lifecycle tests reject authoritative or user-configurable modes.

checks.name: product and Benchmark domains remain isolated
checks.evidence: The candidate is product-only; proof imports exclude Benchmark, truth, Scorer and old claim-promotion dependencies, and no Range answer content was reviewed.

limitations: The final review was read-only and did not execute pytest or a benchmark; it verified source, Git objects, bindings and committed hashes.
The local wheel is ignored; the reviewer checked cross-manifest consistency rather than reading the wheel bytes.
P2 remains shadow, and this review does not approve P5 runtime cutover or authority.
attestation: I performed a read-only proof-security final_soundness review of commit 45ee3de1d637cc72434f656cac4b589aa5fc0750 and tree 14eae235198d884da2f3a8975a4d5e3d643a0336 at maximum reasoning depth. I confirmed the external_entry_parameter_binding hardening fails closed without an explicitly frozen entry-signature domain, the absent-domain test exists, the post-candidate range is evidence-only, and candidate, tree, wheel and test bindings are consistent. I found zero blocking findings and no false fact acceptance, terminal contribution, premature P5 authority, post-terminal model/tool call or unsubstantiated mandatory gate. I did not edit files, run a benchmark or test suite, or read Range truth, benchmark answers, Scorer inputs, secrets or credentials.
